item.title: Mazatlán is projected to receive 160 cruise ships in 2026
item.description: This represents a 20 per cent increase compared to this year. Mazatlán could see a 20 per cent increase in cruise ship arrivals, with 160 cruise ships expected in 2026, compared to 124 this year, reported Mariel Aquileo Ancona Infanzón. item.title: Diana and Adriana, reported missing in Mazatlán, have been located.
item.description: Adriana Guadalupe Saucedo Correa, 34, and Diana Vanessa Meza Astorga, 31, have been located, the State Attorney General’s Office (FGE) reported. The Attorney General’s Office thanks the public for their assistance, as both women disappeared near a residence on Camarón Sábalo Avenue on December 13, 2025. item.title: More than 79,000 new tourists visited Mazatlán in 2025
item.description: Mazatlán, known as “The Pearl of the Pacific,” is one of Mexico’s top tourist destinations thanks to its picturesque scenery, gastronomy, culture, and more, attracting many new tourists. item.title: BreakingNews Reports indicate a sharp depreciation in the Sinaloa real estate market
item.description: The real estate market is experiencing a sharp decline in the state. item.title: In 2025, 715 sea turtle nests were rescued in Mazatlán.
item.description: During 2025, 715 sea turtle nests were rescued on Mazatlán’s beaches as part of a protection program operating along a 16-kilometer stretch of coastline. This stretch extends from Cerritos Beach to Olas Altas.
